owner_posts.post_text:
How Technology is Transforming Inclusive Special Education Today

Special education is undergoing rapid transformation driven by new technologies, innovative teaching strategies, and evolving education policies. For schools like TABIS, this means creating learning environments where every child can thrive academically, socially, and emotionally. Advanced tools such as artificial intelligence, virtual and augmented reality, and assistive devices enable personalized and inclusive education by adapting to each student’s unique needs and learning styles. These technologies improve communication and engagement through features like speech-generating devices and interactive multimedia, while data-driven approaches help educators tailor instruction effectively. Alongside these technological advances, modern teaching methods focus more on social-emotional learning and collaboration between students, teachers, and families, fostering a supportive community. Collectively, these changes are reshaping special education to be more equitable, flexible, and effective, ensuring that all students, regardless of their abilities, have the opportunity to reach their full potential in an inclusive and nurturing environment.

How to Design a Sensory-Friendly Classroom in a Busy School

Designing a sensory-friendly classroom in Mumbai’s bustling school environment is both a challenge and a necessity. With constant noise, crowded spaces, and urban distractions, children with sensory needs can easily feel overwhelmed. A well-planned sensory classroom supports their ability to learn, regulate emotions, and feel included. Teachers can begin by incorporating calming elements such as soft lighting, natural colors, and noise-dampening materials to reduce overstimulation. Flexible seating, quiet corners, and sensory tools like fidget items or textured mats allow students to choose what helps them focus best. Clear organization, visual schedules, and minimal clutter also create predictability, easing anxiety. Importantly, sensory-friendly design benefits every child—not just those with identified needs—by fostering a calmer and more supportive environment. In Mumbai’s fast-paced schools, such classrooms are not just accommodations but a step toward inclusive and holistic education that values the unique learning needs of all students.

Parental Involvement and Advocacy for Special Education | TABIS

Parental involvement in special education plays a crucial role in a child’s overall development. When parents actively collaborate with teachers, therapists, and school counselors, they help create a consistent support system that addresses the child’s unique learning needs. This partnership ensures that educational strategies are reinforced at home, enabling children to practice and master important skills. Parents also advocate for their child’s rights, track progress, and provide emotional encouragement, which boosts the child’s confidence and motivation. Such involvement fosters independence, improves social and academic outcomes, and empowers children with special needs to thrive in both school and everyday life.

Special Needs & Adolescence: Guiding Puberty and Emotional Growth

During adolescence, a child explores and learns about themselves and their identity, including their body and sexuality. For children with special needs, however, this time of growth can bring more difficulty because of the physical and emotional changes they may experience.

The advanced sports playground encompasses a full-size soccer pitch (FIFA approved turf), multiple cricket pitches, athletic tracks, professional stadium lights, facilities for changing, washing and storing and a specialised full pitch skeleton drain system for all weather play.

The All Stars Football Club led by Abhishek Bachchan, Ishaan Khattar, Dino Morea, Jim Sarbh, Shabir Ahluwalia, Sachin Joshi, and other celebrities played an exhibition match with the school football team to mark the opening of the playground. This is undoubtedly an exciting event bringing celebrities and sports enthusiasts together.

The All Stars Football Club is an initiative by GS Sports and Bunty Walia wherein a team of celebrities from all walks of life play football to generate money for noble causes while promoting the sport of the football.

Trustee Sujay Jairaj emphasizes that Sports has always been an integral part of Education at their schools and adds, “This full FIFA size football pitch along with a professional running track and stadium lights with multi-sport capabilities will be a boon for sports development. We will have sporting academies which will help the students to perform better at national and international levels.”

Sporting activities are an integral part of the education offered at Jamnabai Narsee School and no stone is left unturned in providing the infrastructure and opportunity. featured_reviews.review_text:
We are extremely happy with our experience at Kookaburra School. This is our baby’s second year here, and the journey so far has been truly heartwarming to witness.

Over the past year, we’ve seen a remarkable transformation—from initial hesitation to now being confident, expressive, and genuinely excited about going to school every day. The nurturing environment, patient guidance, and warmth shown by the teachers and staff have played a huge role in this growth.

What we appreciate the most is the individual attention given to each child, the focus on overall development (not just academics), and the consistent effort to make learning fun and engaging. The school has created a safe, happy, and stimulating space where children can truly thrive.

featured_reviews.name: shweta goyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I want to thank Tejal Miss and all the teachers and other staff members of kookaburra learning Center.
I don’t think there could have been a better place than kookaburra for my 1 year old. They way the transition the kids from 15 mins to 4 hours over 2 months is beautiful.. from once letting go a crying kid to now watching her being so excited to go meet the teachers, only gives me more comfort that she is at the right place.
They not only celebrate every small festival and days but make learning so much more fun. When we saw the video (On grand parents day) of what and how they are teaching the kids I realized why the kids are so excited to meet the teachers, because for them learning is like playing a game. My daughter is just 16 months and she knows colors, animals, birds, modes of transport, greetings and so much more and with each passing day I see her learning more and more.
I had heard a lot about Tejal Miss and her style of teaching and now when I see my daughter and the massive growth in her I understand sometimes all you need is to trust the process.
I have always been a strong believer of early learning and doing it right, I would never show her screen, read books to her every single day, ensure she has outdoor play time and I am so glad I found a place with similar mindset as mine.
When she started she was only 12 months old and though I felt slightly nervous but my family felt this is way too early and probably not the right thing to do, but after meeting Tejal miss on Grand Parents day as well as watching the video... both my set of parents have come back to say, this is the best thing you could have done for your child.
And it is not just about learning a curriculum, the fact that she concentrates so much more over essential life skills itself shows that is exactly what is to be focused at this age. Making them sit on high chair, getting them used to wearing an apron, placing table mats, praying before eating, and then guiding them how to eat. this isn't easy and yet the school does it flawlessly every single day.
Thank you so much for providing a safe space for our my little girl, every morning when I drop her and watch her excitedly run to her teacher I go back home with a bigger smile. And it's just been few months, I can't wait to see what this place will do in coming years.

featured_reviews.name: Darshit Valia
featured_reviews.review_text: It has been approximately 3 months since my daughter has joined Kookaburra and we cannot be happier. She has adjusted very well and is looking forward to going to school everyday. This is undoubtedly down to the handwork and dedication of Tejal Ma’am and the entire staff at the school. They treat our child as their own and look into the tiniest detail for the overall good development of the child. Sending our daughter to Kookaburra is the best decision we have made. Excellent school.
